blockers_and_next_steps: Do not change production labels or registries from this audit alone; v2 candidates are proposal-only.
Expert review should prioritize support-rich coarse groups before using sublabels as evaluation targets.
Future model evaluation should report v1 primary accuracy plus v2 sublabel-stratified failure modes to avoid mistaking broad cofactor/fold transfer for mechanism understanding.
Rows assigned from curator rationale are review-only and cannot be used as predictive model features.

expected_candidate_gaps.reason: The v1 group name includes oxidase/oxygenase-like chemistry, but current deterministic curated-artifact rules assigned all 20 heme primary rows to peroxidase/catalase-like support.
Two primary flavin rows route to a monooxygenase-like boundary candidate, and two additional flavin_monooxygenase rows already exist as secondary-only probes.

forbidden_feature_policy.separation_rule: Sublabel assignments in this artifact are proposal/review metadata only and must not become model inputs or production labels without explicit approval.

scope.purpose: Re-examine whether v1 primary fingerprints are too coarse for representation-learning evaluation before scaling more models.

v1_reexamination_conclusion.reason: The v1 primary classes test broad mechanism/cofactor buckets, but metal hydrolase, PLP, flavin, and heme each collapse chemically distinct subfamilies that can inflate apparent representation performance by fold or cofactor transfer.
